decisions.reason: Changing coded-referral ticket issuance from one ticket to four does not alter the independently defined coded-referral commission behavior; the accepted $35 commission is already represented by its own same-message Event.
The source Requirement changes the coded-referral path, not no-referral ticket allocation. The separately accepted six-ticket no-code behavior is already represented by its own same-message Event.
A same-message FAQ MODIFY already replaces the prior reward explanation with four tickets per coded referral and therefore requires no additional or corrected Event.
The coded-referral ticket-count change does not alter no-referral commission allocation. The separately accepted $12 no-code commission is already represented by its own same-message Event.
The number of tickets issued after an accepted coded referral does not change which referral identifiers are valid or the prohibition on self-referrals.
Changing the reward quantity does not affect the NFT token serial used as the permanent referral identity or where that identity is displayed.
The current About-page state describes Small Block tickets generically and contains no per-coded-referral ticket quantity that must be changed.
Issuing four tickets instead of one does not change the rule that active tickets follow the NFT upon transfer.
The current landing-page requirement explicitly says each referral adds one entry, which conflicts with the newly accepted four-ticket coded-referral rule.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The logic itself sounds good to me.

After 34 mints, the leaderboard now shows 24 tickets and 19 commissions, which is perfect.

The NFT attributes are still not right, though. My screenshots show that NFT #42 has 18 tickets and 9 x $35 commissions on the leaderboard, which is correct. When I open NFT #42, the top of the page also correctly displays 18 tickets and 14 referrals. However, its attributes still report only 6 referrals and $85 in total earnings.

prize_marketing_copy_requirements: Use claim $900 every 750 sales! where appropriate.
Use the headline $900 prize draw every 750 sales where appropriate.
State: 3 affiliates chosen from every 750-sale block. Each coded referral adds four entries!
Continue to show $900, 750 sales, a 750-sales block, and three affiliates where those mechanics are described.

decisions.reason: The metadata requirement already requires accurate ticket data dynamically and contains no current one-ticket-per-coded-referral attribute to replace; the same message's stale-attribute observation is execution evidence rather than a new MODIFY.

The reporting requirement remains that leaderboard and summary values accurately reflect underlying rewards; changing the underlying coded ticket quantity does not alter that requirement, and the same message already supplies verification evidence.
The coded-referral ticket quantity does not alter email delivery, notification channels, or the currently required transactional email contents.
